title: Observational Indistinguishability and Integrity Blind Regions in Hybrid Quantum-Classical Workflows
description: Version 1.3.4 is the final corrective bibliographic/editorial release of Paper 1.5. No experiment, kernel, model, dataset, seed, attack, draw, intervention, policy decision, scientific result or formal theorem was re-executed or changed. Derived metadata/coverage artifacts were regenerated from the frozen code/evidence to correct an inconsistency; scientific observations and decisions are unchanged. The experimental evidence remains frozen at version 1.3.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22648573), and the methodology remains unchanged from 1.3.2. Every bibliography entry was verified against a primary source with cutoff 2026-09-08; the release corrects objective author, title, venue, date and identifier metadata, adds bounded conformal and CICIDS2017 context, and aligns the manuscript, supplement, reproduction guide and submission package. The central contribution remains claim-relative minimum evidence granularity in a workflow-wide information-set lattice: a trusted same-batch aggregate reference can certify conclusion or aggregate integrity, item-identity integrity requires item-aligned trusted evidence, and some trust root outside the declared adversarial rewrite class is unavoidable. Contents include code, tests, eight SHA-256 evidence manifests, compact derived evidence, the machine-readable bibliography audit, figures, formal core, adversary model, manuscript sources and submission PDFs.
